input.quote: (x) Servicing Procedures. It has complied in all material respects with the Servicing Procedures with respect to the Receivables.
input.rationale: The Servicer's obligations run to a performance standard (Section 3.2(a): \"with reasonable care using that degree of skill and attention that the Servicer exercises for all comparable device payment plan agreement receivables\") and Section 6.1(a) contains point-in-time reps on compliance with Law and with the Servicing Procedures. There is, however, no conformance warranty for the receivables systems/software or reports the Servicer delivers, no warranty duration, and no repair, replacement or refund remedy — the only remedy machinery is acquisition of affected Receivables, expressly stated as the sole remedy for the narrow Section 3.2(b)-(d) breaches. That fails every fallback element, so we insert the shortest fallback warranty (90 days software conformance to documentation, 30 days services) with repair/replacement or refund. Section 3.3(g)'s sole-remedy language is confined to Section 3.2(b)/(c)/(d) and so does not swallow the new warranty; the new remedy is drafted as a specific Servicer obligation for purposes of Section 6.2(a).

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.

proposal.summary: Add a fallback-level performance warranty (90-day software conformance, 30-day services) with repair/replacement or refund remedies as a new Servicer representation in Section 6.1(a).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement gives us no conformance warranty or warranty remedy for the Servicer's systems and servicing work, so we added the playbook fallback warranty (90 days for software, 30 days for services) with repair, replacement or refund. We can discuss the preferred 12-month software period if that is easier to align with the servicing systems.

ops.text: Performance Warranty. The Servicer warrants that, for 90 days after delivery, any software and receivables systems it provides or makes available to the Issuer under this Agreement will conform in all material respects to their documentation, and that, for 30 days after performance, its servicing and other services under this Agreement will conform to this Agreement and the Servicing Procedures. For a breach of this warranty, the Servicer will, at the Issuer's option, repair or replace the non-conforming software, system or services or refund the Servicing Fee paid for them.
